text: Traders sold Gavin Newsom overnight, pushing the blended price down 1.3 points to 10.0. The move was all Polymarket, with Kalshi holding flat. The odds that Gretchen Whitmer enters the race rose 13 points on Kalshi, to 48 percent, even though Whitmer's nomination price barely moved. Jon Ossoff leads both the markets, at 26.3, and the model, winning 29.3 percent of 20,000 simulated primaries. About 11 in 100 simulated primaries end without a pledged majority, which sends the fight to the convention floor. Watch the Newsom price first when the books update tonight. We also changed how the model works today, which accounts for much of its movement.
